description: This file defines the ContactsService class, which implements contact management functionalities such as searching and adding contacts using the iOS Contacts framework. It includes methods for searching contacts by name, adding new contacts with validation, permission handling, and contact matching logic.

classes.name: ContactsService
classes.description: A final class providing contact searching and adding functionalities, handling permissions and contact matching.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Search contacts based on provided parameters, supporting query filtering and limit restrictions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Add a new contact after validating input, avoiding duplicates, and assigning contact details.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Check and handle authorization status for contact access, potentially prompting user.

methods.name: authorizedStore
methods.description: Obtain an authorized CNContactStore instance if permission is granted.

methods.name: normalizeStrings
methods.description: Trim and optionally lowercase an array of strings for comparison.

methods.name: findExistingContact
methods.description: Search for existing contacts matching phone numbers or emails to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: matchContacts
methods.description: Match contacts based on normalized phone numbers and emails.

methods.name: normalizePhone
methods.description: Normalize phone numbers by extracting digits for comparison.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Create a payload data structure from a CNContact for output.
